resources.string: Hides the Shorts button in YouTube and the Reels button in Instagram by covering it, and can also close Shorts and Reels that open another way. It only looks at the YouTube and Instagram apps, and nothing leaves your phone. On Android 11 and newer it reads the colour of one pixel next to the button so the cover blends in.

Turn on Short-Form Blocker in your phone\'s Accessibility settings. That lets it find the Shorts and Reels buttons and cover them. It only looks at YouTube and Instagram, and nothing leaves your phone.
The Shorts and Reels buttons are hidden in YouTube and Instagram.

Is the switch greyed out (\"Restricted setting\")? Android does that for apps installed outside the Play Store. Open App info, tap ⋮ in the top corner, choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
Hides the Shorts button in YouTube and the Reels button in Instagram by covering it. Android doesn\'t let apps remove parts of other apps, so a gap is left where the button was.
Also close Shorts and Reels opened another way
For example from a thumbnail in the feed. The app pauses them and goes back.

YouTube and Instagram sometimes rename their screens in updates. Turn this on, open YouTube or Instagram where the button wasn\'t hidden (or a Short or Reel that got through), then come back and share the report. It lists layout names and the labels of the bottom buttons, never content.
No ads, no tracking, no internet access.
